summary: Merged rules reviewed and tested locally. The portal uses UID roles, group/child ACLs, bounded schemas, server review timestamps and optimistic versions. Critical self-enrollment and unverified-email holes are closed. Legacy compatibility limitations remain; this is not a certification of the deployed project.

findings.issue: FIXED: original self-created profiles could choose instructor and read approved-user data. New self-enrollment only permits pending. Previously created instructors remain trusted.
findings.recommendation: Update the legacy registration form and review previously self-enrolled staff.

findings.issue: FIXED: legacy email-key authority now requires email_verified.
findings.recommendation: Verify legacy admin email addresses and migrate privileged profiles to UID keys.

findings.issue: Legacy assessments still authorize by coach name/coachKey; approved legacy staff still read all legacy students/Schedules. Preserved because legacy schema/migration code was not supplied.
findings.recommendation: Migrate legacy records to coach UID and group ACLs before assuming equivalent isolation across both systems.

findings.issue: Legacy assessments and several admin write rules retain permissive field validation. Portal collections have strict bounded validators and version checks.
findings.recommendation: Audit real legacy fields and migrate create/update validation together.

findings.issue: Authorized users can still consume the shared free quota. Images use small Firestore documents; cleanup requires an admin browser to open.
findings.recommendation: Pilot on a small dataset, watch quotas, exempt image payloads from indexing, and add pagination plus an appropriate image store before scaling.

findings.issue: Activity entries are client-written append-only records, not a complete server-owned audit trail.
findings.recommendation: Add server-owned auditing if compliance-grade event history becomes required.
